_comment: Pinned mapping of Hermes bytecode format version -> exact `hermes-compiler` npm version. Mirrors vendor/hermes-dec's git_tags.sh (which pins facebook/hermes source commits per bytecode version), but for the standalone `hermes-compiler` npm package instead of a full react-native/Expo app - installs in ~1s with zero transitive dependencies, instead of the 30-280s+ / hundreds-of-packages a full RN sandbox app needs. Verified empirically: `npm i hermes-compiler@<version>` then `hermesc -version` reports the listed bytecode_version.

96.notes: Earliest npm_version that still resolves (0.14.0) works equally; 0.14.1 picked arbitrarily as a clean pin point.

97.notes: No standalone hermes-compiler npm release covers bytecode 97 (short-lived 'Hermes static' build, per vendor/hermes-dec/src/hermes_dec/utils/git_tags.sh commit 16b5ada). Build hermesc from source at that commit, or extract it from a react-native version known to bundle it, if this version is ever needed.

98.notes: Matches the commit vendor/hermes-dec pins for bytecode 98 (becc964 / hermes-v250829098.0.10) for traceability. Any 250829098.0.x patch (.0.0 through at least .0.19 seen on npm) reports the same bytecode version.
